title: clidemia linearis

It has been used in traditional medicine for various purposes, with health benefits including its potential to reduce inflammation, improve wound healing, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of Clidemia linearis include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
